name: ODABA
tagline: RUN Software's terminology-oriented object database for C++ and .NET, still released on SourceForge.
description: ODABA is an object database from the German company RUN Software-Werkstatt that extends ODMG-style object storage with what its authors call a terminology model: multilingual attributes, set relations, weakly typed collections and hierarchical classifications, so the schema doubles as documented domain terminology. Applications use C++ or .NET APIs or the ODABA Script Interface, whose ODL and OQL follow ODMG 3.0, and the bundled ODE tools and Active Data Link GUI framework generate data-bound user interfaces; schemas can also be mirrored to SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle or XML. Version 17 added a web database server, and 17.3.1 was published on SourceForge in March 2026 under the GPL. It is a niche, single-vendor system best suited to teams already invested in its modelling approach.

pricing.notes: Free download under the GPL; services and support from RUN Software.

strengths: Rich conceptual modelling: multilingual attributes, set relations and classifications
ODMG 3.0-style ODL/OQL plus C++ and .NET APIs
Can mirror data to relational databases or XML
weaknesses: Tiny community; documentation is dense and partly German-centric
Unusual concepts take time to learn
useCases: Rapid development of data-bound desktop GUIs with ODE tools
